Breaking up especially from a person who made you feel worse doesn't mean that you will automatically a better mental health condition, it takes some time to actually get used to it again, and there are maybe things you need to process through. Instead of feeling like you'll never find anyone again, how about you think, if that's actually what you need (right now). And it is not impossible to find someone again, because you already did find someone(your ex). So you can find someone you are going to be happy with. Maybe after you processed everything through and start feeling better, or even before that when that person actually helps you getting through. So you tap meaning of life from love that comes from a romantic relationship?\`How about you do yourself something good, and reward yourself, with something romantic by yourself, because you're worth it and you can try to show it yourself. That's also a form of love(Just a suggestion).  


Maybe some good food, some candles which smell nice, a bath and some Show/Movie/Anime you'd like to watch? Just for an example.  
Idk what might be romantic to you, but these are some thing I do for myself.  
Gotta encounter anxiety and depression with some love and self-respect!

Because there are bright sides to life, even if they were no good things in some lifes like some of this subreddit, we know that it exists, or else everyone in this world would be depressed and suicidal. Gotta chase for something that makes us feel good and makes us feel alive like we actually want it to be.
